main_text.p: Ptolemæus terram habitatam uersus Septentrionem ab æquatore ad 63 gradum latitudinis boreæ extendit, & hunc tractum 29 Parallelis distinguit. Quorum priores 25 tanto interuallo disiunguit, quanto horæ quadrante maxima dies accrescit. Reliquos quatuor ampliore aliquanto seclusdit spacio minus accurate, et umbrarum Meridianarum differentias annotat, hoc spacium uniuersum, si initium à ueteribus constitutum ac præfixum retineatur, in 15 climata diduci potest hoc modo, & si Ptolemæus alibi retinet Climatum numerum à ueteribus traditum.
main_text.head: F
main_text.p: Nostra ætate cum & maxima Solis declinatio mutata sit, & plurima ad septuagesimum primum usq; latitudinis boreæ gradum et ultrà loca in noticiam uenerint: ex definitione climatum, talis eorundem distributio institui potest, qualem sequens ostendit tabella, quam ex eruditissima Parallelorum & climatum descriptione à clarissimo uiro, et harum artium peritissimo artifice M. ERASMO REINHOLD communi præceptore nostro, contraxi ad 66 gradum, 31 scrupulum usq;. Vltra hanc

page.notes: The initial F is a large woodcut-style letter; a marginal fragment at the left edge is not printed text. Some words in the first paragraph are faint and marked where uncertain: "seclusdit" should probably read "seclusit" (printed as shown, left unchanged). Catchword "Vltra hanc" is read from the foot line.
